_readme: Small config the agent reads/writes each run. artifactUrl is filled in after the first successful publish and must be reused (not regenerated) on every subsequent run so updates land on the same page instead of creating a new one each day.
pagesPublishScope: every run — uses GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN if set (scheduled cloud runs), else the local gh CLI
lastRunStatus: Weekly research run. No evidenceScore changes; four opportunities updated with new evidence. (1) ai-bifurcates-it-staffing-support-contracts-infra-grows stayed at 4: BLS released its 2025-35 Employment Projections cycle (Aug 27, 2026), a second independent projection cycle confirming the bifurcation -- computer support specialists' -3% decline is now shown to be user-support-only (network support specialists separately project +1%), and computer programmers newly enter the contracting side at -7%, AI-attributed. This broke BLS's 10-run dead-source streak. (2) engineers-shift-to-orchestration-oversight stayed at 4: added Forrester's 'Beyond the Wave' (37 autonomous-testing-platform customers) quantifying a real ceiling on full test-automation autonomy (2.2/5) despite 51-60% average automation. (3) entry-level-hiring-contraction-mixed-evidence stayed at 4, now contested with a fifth contradicting source: NBER working paper w35796 (Fairlie & Wu, issued Sept 2026) uses CPS microdata across eight specifications and finds no AI-exposure-linked unemployment spike among recent college graduates in summer 2026 -- the most directly on-point contradiction yet (same population as this trail's lead WEF/PwC evidence), but per rubric 4e's non-stacking rule does not add to the -1 downgrade already applied. (4) ai-workforce-impact-slowly-rising-tide stayed at 4: a red-team search aimed at reversing this gradual-impact thesis instead surfaced a second, independent NBER paper ('Mind the Gap,' w34995) that corroborates it from a cross-country industry-panel angle -- added as supporting evidence, not a contradiction. No new opportunities founded. Product Management (still thinnest at 1) had a fifth consecutive run closed negative -- every lead folds the role into a broader leadership bucket with no role-specific breakout. Red-teamed all thirteen evidenceScore>=4 opportunities; the two NBER findings above were the only new threshold-clearing results, and neither moved a score (one non-stacking contradiction, one same-institution corroboration). Forrester and NBER both reset to 0 consecutiveEmptyRuns on genuine new admissible findings. MIT CISR's own Oct 15, 2026 briefing announced the center will cease operations Oct 31, 2026 -- flagged in sources.json and the findings log; this mandatory priority source will go permanently dark within two weeks and AGENT_PROMPT.md section 1 will need updating once its site stops publishing. McKinsey (8) and Deloitte Insights (7) continue climbing without a new admissible finding; OECD newly crossed to 7. None read as genuinely dead.
pagesTokenPermissions: fine-grained PAT, repository access limited to sdm1130/ai-it-research-tracker, Contents: Read and write (Metadata: Read-only is added automatically). Nothing else required: main has no branch protection or rulesets, and Pages is build_type=legacy on main:/ so it rebuilds on push.

pagesPublishExitCodes.3: no credentials — skip and report mirror stale
pagesPublishExitCodes.1: real failure e.g. expired token — report loudly
